name: Offspring
description: An exuberant drama set in Melbourne's Fitzroy, centering on Nina Proudman and her struggle to deal with her fabulously messy family, her hunt for a decent love life and her tendency to overthink and fly off into fantasy.

videos.title: Pilot - Telemovie
videos.overview: Nina Proudman involves herself in helping her family from their own chaotic lives. Free of family obligations, Nina then arrives back at her flat to find an reminder of her ex-husband Brendan, undying love. Back at work, Nina overhears gossip about her crush, new employee Chris' past. Billie attempts 'make-up sex' with boyfriend Mick, however a fight erupts when he fails to take her career seriously and Billie reiterates why they can't be together. Heavily pregnant Cherie returns to the hospital for a check-up with old friend and workmate Nina. Before she can leave, Cherie goes into premature labour. During the delivery the women realise the baby's father is Nina's dad, Darcy.

videos.title: Taking Charge
videos.overview: Nina vows to take charge of her love life, but as things with Brendan come to an end, Chris struggles to explain his past and Nina is left uncertain about their relationship. The Proudman family adjust to life with their newest member, Baby Ray.

videos.title: The Uncomfortability
videos.overview: Nina's insecurities are revealed when a patient poses an awkward request. Meanwhile Geraldine decides to try online dating, and Jimmy is an unexpected saviour to Cherie and Darcy.

videos.title: Playing Aloof
videos.overview: Believing she interrupted Chris and Zara having sex in the storeroom, Nina spends a sleepless night struggling with her feelings. When Chris finally corners her to talk, Nina protects herself from further humiliation and pretends to be completely unfazed by the whole incident. Cherie and Darcy host a naming ceremony for Baby Ray that sends the Proudman women into a spin. Billie goes to great lengths to make Mick jealous and Jimmy realises that lying has its limits.

videos.title: Poison Ivy
videos.overview: Love struck Nina struggles to keep focused on everyday life as she's plagued by fantasies of Dr Havel. Billie's plan to make Mick jealous backfires when his old flame, Ivy, shows up. Meanwhile, Cherie and Darcy negotiate the rules of dating as Darcy has a life changing one night stand.

videos.title: Carpe Diem
videos.overview: Nina and Chris attempt to seize the moment, but their future is threatened by a complicated past. Cherie's secretive behaviour prompts Billie to start playing detective, and Jimmy and Odile come to a crossroads in their relationship.

videos.title: D-Day
videos.overview: Nina thinks the worst of her day is over, when, on the morning of her date with Chris Havel, she finds herself navigating the elaborate world of contraception and facing serious performance anxiety issues. Meanwhile, Billie continues to investigate Cherie's mysterious behaviour with an older man, Mick and Ivy break up as he admits he still loves Billie, and much to Jimmy's disgust, Geraldine seems to have the most luck in the bedroom with Mr Soriel, Jimmy's old history teacher.

videos.title: Two Sisters
videos.overview: Suppressing her feelings, Nina gives Chris some space as he travels to Queensland in search of his missing wife. But with Chris away, and plagued by her own insecurities, Nina makes one very big mistake that will change everything. Meanwhile, Billie can't bring herself to make up with Mick, and Darcy finally learns about Cherie's secret past.

videos.title: Re-Unravel
videos.overview: Plagued by the guilt of sleeping with Mick, Nina faces Chris and blurts out the truth. To her surprise he doesn't pass judgement, but could a surprise visitor cause everything to unravel again?

videos.title: Making Peace
videos.overview: Still in shock after Alice's unexpected arrival, Nina feels the urge to make peace with her own past and goes to see Brendan. Meanwhile, Billie rights a wrong and as a result, proves her love for Mick.

videos.title: The Other Woman
videos.overview: Nina struggles with being the other woman in Chris' life. Meanwhile, Billie reluctantly becomes Stacey's birthing partner and Jimmy gets more than he bargained for as a human test subject.

videos.title: My Confessions
videos.overview: Almost as shocking as the act itself, Nina will shatter her sister’s new found loved-up happiness with Mick, when she finally brings herself to tell Billie what she did. But not before Mick tells Nina he is going to tell Billie himself and Nina can’t stop him. Nina has an awkward meeting with Chris’ wife Alice, where, unable to stop imagining the fallout from Mick’s confession, she cuts her meeting short then inadvertently runs over Alice’s foot in her haste to drive off and confront Billie.

videos.title: Not As Planned
videos.overview: Nina's life has gone from bad to worse since her family discovered her secret. Nobody is willing to forgive her, least of all Billie, and her relationship with Chris is in tatters. Nina is offered a job in Baltimore and decides to take the offer. Nina and Billie have a confrontation at the Hospital. Cherie and Sam take their relationship to the next level.

videos.title: A New Miracle
videos.overview: Nina prepares to say goodbye and pack up her things. Jimmy organises a farewell BBQ, but is unfortunately shutdown by rain. Kim goes into labour at the pub and gives birth to a baby girl. Billie and Nina make amends. Chris and Nina are left at a crossroads.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: After spending five months in Baltimore, Nina returns home after receiving news of her father Darcy's heart attack. Billie and Mick are now living at Nina's apartment and trying for a baby. Jimmy also returns after being abroad with new girlfriend Tammy. Nina finds out that Chris has moved to Brisbane with Alice and Lucy. Darcy asks Geraldine to renew their vows and Nina meets a new obstetrician, Fraser King, at the hospital.

videos.title: Baby Bumps
videos.overview: Nina and Fraser continue to get to know each other. Cherie returns to her job as a nurse at the hospital. Billie and Mick discover they will have to go through IVF in order to have a baby. Nina goes on a date with her fathers doctor Ben. Billie reveals to Mick she had two abortions during her teens.

videos.title: Dates, Decisions & Divorces
videos.overview: Billie and Mick continue to experience fertility problems and in desperation Billie asks Nina to consider being a surrogate for the couple without telling Mick of her plan. Darcy has another health scare while practicing for the honeymoon and Chris arrives back in time to see Nina kissing Fraser in the emergency department.

videos.title: Together We Are One
videos.overview: Nina and her work colleagues are up in arms about the new anaesthetist, Patrick. Meanwhile, Jimmy and Mick console each other after their respective partners insult their manhood.

videos.title: The Way You Are
videos.overview: Nina struggles to decide on a course of action after Fraser freezes again during a routine consultation. Meanwhile, Mick and Andrew fight over old issues, and Jimmy is upset by his parents' hypocrisy.

videos.title: Behind Closed Doors
videos.overview: When Cherie discovers that Jimmy and Tammy are planning a secret wedding, Nina rallies the Proudmans in an attempt to reunite her family. Amidst the chaos, Billie, Mick and Andrew try to make a baby.

videos.title: Cheating On Your Test
videos.overview: After a tragedy at work, Nina and Patrick console each other. Could this new intimacy lead to something more? Meanwhile, Billie and Mick get the results of their pregnancy test.

videos.title: Two Different Places
videos.overview: Exhilarated after their night of passion, Nina is determined to master the art of a casual fling. Patrick, however, seems to want something more.

videos.title: Just Keep Talking
videos.overview: Determined to be professional and forget her personal problems with Patrick, Nina is alarmed when Clegg requests they write a report together.

videos.title: Acceptance
videos.overview: Nina hosts a dinner party at Patrick's, where he charms the Proudmans.

videos.title: Complications
videos.overview: Nina and Patrick decide to fight for their relationship, but could an email from Chris Havel throw a spanner in the works? Meanwhile, Darcy and Geraldine plan a family intervention for Jimmy.

videos.title: What Goes Around Comes Around
videos.overview: Nina's life is thrown into a spin by the return of Chris Havel. How will our leading lady juggle two gentlemen callers? Meanwhile, Billie meets Mick's mother, and Cherie faces a health scare with Ray.

videos.title: Proudman Wedding Curse
videos.overview: Nina makes an important decision about her love life; meanwhile, Billie and Mick try to defy the Proudman Wedding Curse, and Cherie uncovers a shocking family secret.

videos.title: Happiness is a Delusion
videos.overview: Nina Proudman is floating on cloud nine. She's in love with Dr Patrick Reid and happy in her job - but is everything about to change?

videos.title: Secrets and Lies
videos.overview: Still reeling after learning of her true parents, Nina meets with Darcy to find out how he's coping. Both hurt and confused by the news, Nina and Darcy downplay their feelings trying to save their pain.

videos.title: Fertility Woes
videos.overview: Burying concerns over the identity of her biological father, Nina focuses on the hunt for a rental property with Patrick. Nina's only forced to confront the issue when Billie reveals she located one of the possibilities. Billie's disappointed to discover her only fertile time of the month coincides with Tim and Andrew's first big date. Jimmy and Zara attend the first ultrasound for their baby.

videos.title: Time
videos.overview: A week after moving in with Patrick, Nina worries that living & working together is putting a strain on their relationship; later, Nina gets a surprise call from Dr Noonan hoping to catch Geraldine.

videos.title: Allegations
videos.overview: Nina arrives at work shocked to discover Patrick is being investigated over an allegation of patient abuse

videos.title: Partners in Crisis
videos.overview: Worried about their first big fight and Patrick's night alone at a motel, Nina finds Patrick at work to apologise. Mick and Rosanna continue to forge their musical partnership...

videos.title: Drink, Drank, Drunk
videos.overview: Proud of the way she's coped post breakup, Nina arrives at work ready to face her first day of surgery with Patrick; determined not to wallow, Cherie takes Nina out for a night of fun and partying...

videos.title: One Night Stand Off
videos.overview: Nina wakes up hung over in a stranger's bed, faced with overwhelming evidence she's had a one night stand. Meanwhile, with Nina missing from work and home, Patrick's concern leads him to investigate...

videos.title: Chaos
videos.overview: Nina finds herself at the heart of Proudman family chaos, while trying to assure Patrick her relationship with Adam is platonic.

videos.title: The Aftermath
videos.overview: Patrick confronts Nina about the serve Billie gave him over their breakup and her new relationship with Adam. Will Nina face the boundaries of her relationship?

videos.title: Goodbye is Always Hard
videos.overview: The reality of Patrick's departure hits Nina as she walks to work. Later at Patrick's farewell, Nina struggles to say a proper goodbye in front of all her workmates.

videos.title: Insecurity
videos.overview: Nina gets a test taken at the hospital; Billie's insecurity about Rosanna intensifies when Mick insists he's still doing the tour with her; meanwhile Billie is forced to spend the day with Ollie.

videos.title: Pregnant Pause
videos.overview: Nina celebrates her 35th birthday at the hospital where Darcy has recreated Nina's 8 year old dream birthday party! It is sure to be a night full of surprises!

videos.title: Outside of the Comfort Zone
videos.overview: Nina and Patrick prepare for parenthood as Billie struggles to cope with Nina’s pregnancy. Meanwhile, a new arrival sparks interest at the hospital.

videos.title: Second Chances
videos.overview: Nina discovers Patrick's mysterious past whilst Billie fights to take over the family.

videos.title: Truth Time
videos.overview: Nina and Patrick try to solve their problems without resorting to sex, at the same time as Nina is forced to tell Patrick the truth about Eloise. Plus, Darcy and Cherie have a big announcement.

videos.title: Keeping It in the Family
videos.overview: Tension runs high between Nina and Darcy as he prepares for his road trip with Cherie. Also, Jimmy tries to keep it in the family by applying for a job as Billie's real estate underling.

videos.title: The Things We Do for Love
videos.overview: Nina is confronted by the nature of Eloise's crush. Billie insists she and Mick meet the press as a power couple and Jimmy's inspired by a new business venture.

videos.title: Difficulty
videos.overview: Nina and Patrick deal with a rather difficult house guest, as Billie attempts to cover her business woes.

videos.title: Smoking Situations
videos.overview: Nina's best intentions with the Reid family cause several rifts in both the Reid & Proudman families. Meanwhile, Billie struggles to work under a new boss as well as coping with a damaging magazine article.

videos.title: Freaking the Freak Out
videos.overview: Nina wonders if her pregnancy with Patrick is enough to keep them together, Patrick struggles with Kate's decision to see her abusive ex-partner Dean and Billie is confronted by Mick's popularity.

videos.title: Numbing the Pain
videos.overview: A dream about counsellor Lawrence has Nina questioning her relationship with Patrick. Billie embarks on a new career and heads for self-destruction. The nurses help Eloise with her love life.

videos.title: Matters of the Heart
videos.overview: Nina and Patrick struggle to negotiate the role of the ever present Proudmans in their life together. Meanwhile, Billie is in damage control after her night out on the town.

videos.title: Dialing Up the Crazy
videos.overview: The Proudman family implodes when Nina and Patrick's counselling session goes public.

videos.title: Goodbye Patrick
videos.overview: Billie and Mick's relationship strains under the weight of her infidelity.

videos.title: The Bond Between Sisters
videos.overview: In the season finale, Nina prepares for the biggest day of her life. Meanwhile, Mick goes on a search to bring Billie home.

videos.title: Back in the Game
videos.overview: Six months after Patrick's death, Nina and Billie are caring for baby Zoe together. Nina is determined to jump back into life and return to work, while Billie counts the days 'til Mick's return.

videos.title: When Sparks Fly
videos.overview: Nina has a blast from the past when she runs into an old flame at the hospital. Billie meets with Lawrence to discuss his feelings. Will sparks fly?

videos.title: Moving On
videos.overview: Nina finds herself stuck at the airport with a handsome stranger and time to kill. Will she take advantage of the situation? Meanwhile, Billie prepares for Mick's return.

videos.title: Winners and Losers
videos.overview: Nina and Billie face their dreaded high school reunion. While Nina tries to convince everyone she's happy to go, Billie has her own reasons not to attend.

videos.title: The Story of My Life
videos.overview: Nina is shocked by the arrival of a new male midwife; Billie is under pressure as Lawrence's apartment goes to auction; Zara surprises Jimmy with a life-changing announcement.

videos.title: Emergencies
videos.overview: Is Nina and Leo's secret airport tryst about to be exposed? Billie puts her broken heart aside to get to know Lawrence before a medical emergency shakes the Proudman family.

videos.title: I'm Always Here
videos.overview: A Proudman life hangs in the balance; Nina faces a huge dilemma; Billie's life takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Expect the Unexpected
videos.overview: It's finally date night for Nina and Thomas, but the night takes an unexpected turn. Meanwhile, Billie presents Jimmy with an interesting business opportunity.

videos.title: Return, Romance, Repeat
videos.overview: Billie finds herself drawn into Nina and Thomas' romantic dinner plans: Jimmy worries about Zara's new obsession; can Clegg handle Cherie's return?

videos.title: Introduction
videos.overview: Billie is calm in the face of Mick's return to Melbourne. Then Nina learns why he's really in town. Can she break the news to Billie? Meanwhile, Thomas gets an unusual introduction to the Proudmans.

videos.title: Love, Pain and the Whole Damn Thing
videos.overview: Billie struggles with the knowledge that Mick is single; Nina deals with the fallout from Thomas meeting the Proudmans; Kim has a shock proposal for Clegg.

videos.title: Life Changing Decisions
videos.overview: Nina and Leo are floored by an unexpected patient at St Francis; Mick asks Billie to come to London with him; Cherie must choose between Kim and Clegg's needs.

videos.title: When Life Gives You Lemons...
videos.overview: As Billie prepares for a new life overseas, Nina faces Zoe's first birthday and the anniversary of Patrick's death. But first the St Francis staff must face an emergency of epic proportions.

videos.title: ...Make Lemonade
videos.overview: Eighteen months after the events of season five, Nina and the Proudman  clan are shaken by tragedy when a family gathering results in explosive  revelations.

videos.title: Doctor, Doctor
videos.overview: Nina and her St Francis colleagues are introduced to the flirtatious and suave new Director of Education, Dr Angus Freeman. Meanwhile, Leo has some shock news in store for Nina.

videos.title: Getting to Know You
videos.overview: Nina gets to know St Francis' alleged "pantsman" Dr Angus Freeman better, with his behaviour leading her to do something out of character.

videos.title: Fallout
videos.overview: At St Francis, Nina deals with the fallout from a date. Meanwhile, Clegg and Cherie's relationship is put to the test as they find themselves suffering from a crisis of confidence.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: The staff at St Francis are shaken by a public relations crisis at the hospital and Nina finds herself clashing with Harry Crewe, the consultant brought in to deal with the issue.

videos.title: A Present from the Past
videos.overview: The staff at St Francis are shocked when an earlier PR crisis explodes into something far more serious. Nina sees a new side to Harry and is rocked by a visitor from Patrick's past.

videos.title: Just Keep Swimming
videos.overview: Dr Patrick returns in Nina's fantasy as she grapples with a dilemma which has major consequences for everyone involved, including Billie.

videos.title: Sisters Aren't Doing It For Themselves
videos.overview: Nina's attempt to do something for Billie spirals into a huge decision which could impact Nina's life forever and threatens to tear the two sisters apart.

videos.title: Tried and Tested
videos.overview: Nina's relationship with Harry is tested when she makes a life-altering decision regarding Patrick.

videos.title: To the Best of My Ability
videos.overview: Billie plays cupid for two hopeless lovers and three generations of Proudman women help Nina do what she does best in a life-affirming moment.

videos.title: Happy Geraldine Day
videos.overview: When Proudman matriarch Geraldine calls the family together for a very special 'Geraldine Day', her announcement at dinner will leave everyone speechless.

videos.title: The End of an Era
videos.overview: Nina is overwhelmed with the demands of her job as acting head of obstetrics, as she supports Billie to make a difficult decision about her marriage with Mick.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After separating from Mick, Billie decides to tackle her grief head-on with a girls night out where Kerry advocates a fool-proof plan to mend Billie's heart.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Mick asks Billie to accompany him to London; Cherie must choose between Kin and Clegg; and Nina and Leo get a shock from a patient.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Eighteen months after the events of season five, Nina and the Proudman clan are shaken by tragedy when a family gathering results in explosive revelations.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Nina and Harry make an important decision about their future. Jimmy summons the courage to tell Zara the truth. Billie's sex wall hits a snag, when her latest "brick", Dan, tries to out-woo her.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Nina battles her doubts as she prepares to interview for the Head of Obstetrics role. Billie's confused after being stood up by Dan. Will Will discover the truth about Kerry and Jimmy's indiscretion?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Nina battles her doubts as she prepares to interview for the Head of Obstetrics role. Billie’s confused after being stood up by Dan. Will Will discover the truth about Kerry and Jimmy’s indiscretion?

videos.overview: Nina and Harry endeavour to bring their families together for the first time. With Harry travelling to Sydney for his new job, it is left to Nina to invite both families. What could possibly go wrong?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Nina faces a big decision, is she ready to leave St. Francis? The Proudman siblings call a crisis meeting in regard to Geraldine.
